words.said: personas that are kind of dispatched on your memory
words.how: Phone and laptop screens show five persona cards (Remind me, Your ideas, New possibilities, Reflect, Make it easier) with one switch each, plus the Keep my memory tidy switch.

visual.summary: Both widths open with the punchline box and show the live Helpers screen with five personas and the tidy switch; the card has no feedback block, which is fine for an evidence page.

reader.asked: Decide whether the five personas read clearly on the Helpers screen, answering yes or no.
reader.note: "Make it easier now finds one easier way each week" could be read as already switched on for testers, or as off until a user switches it on; the evidence says it is off until switched on, but the card line does not say so.

steps.what: open the link 'Before: nine long cards'
